card.name: Inside drug names before dosage form
card.fires_on: The middle of a drug name such as the "oph" in Acetaminophen, or the dosage-form word (oral, Injection) right after a drug name. It appears in drug label dosing and administration text.

modes.label: Middle of acetaminophen
modes.description: The "oph" piece inside Acetaminophen, usually before Injection.
modes.example: the recommended dosage of Acetamin<<oph>>en Injection is 15 mg/kg

modes.description: Words like oral or Injection that directly follow a generic drug name.
modes.example: when clobazam<< oral>> suspension is used with opioids

modes.label: Inside other drug names
modes.description: Partway through other drug names such as beclomethasone dipropionate.
modes.example: Discontinue beclomethasone<< dip>>ropionate HFA inhalation aerosol
